title: Humdinger Sportfishing

services.name: Fishing Season
services.desc: Captain Jeff Fay has been fishing in Kona Hawaii for over 50 years and is known throughout the worldwide sportfishing community. Humdinger Sportfishing offers a variety of exclusive fishing charters in Kona for up to six anglers. We provide everything you need to have a fun and successful day of fishing in Kona. Kona Fishing charters are one of the most popular activities in Hawaii, and because the fishing in Kona happens so close to the shoreline, you spend almost all of your time fishing and less time running out and back to the fishing grounds.
